decision: Started from a clean origin/main worktree
why: The current checkout was a merged feature branch and would mix unrelated history
result: clean feature branch

decision: Used named account profiles and a model capability catalog as the leading design candidates
why: Read-only architecture scout found one key drives several unsynchronized artifacts and model facts are scattered
result: design exploration open

decision: Defined the run exit predicate
why: The unattended run needs an objective stop condition
result: predicate defined

decision: Ran every local CI-equivalent shell check before changes
why: A clean baseline separates existing failures from regressions
evidence: shellcheck; bash -n; tests/statusline.sh; tests/extractors.sh; tests/model-routing.sh; install.sh --help
result: 24 behavior tests and all checks green

decision: Chose the dark-mode qBraid violet for terminal branding and kept credit warning colors
why: The published brand spends one violet accent on chrome and permits separate state colors
result: brand facts captured

decision: Opened the visual architecture report and chose account profiles as the first deepening
why: Account cross-talk can charge and display different organizations; profiles also give model state a stable owner
result: report opened; selection implicit from user request

decision: Kept Opus adaptive thinking blocked pending an API fix
why: A live production request returned HTTP 400 because qbraid-api changed adaptive to enabled
result: reproduced exact failure

decision: Confirmed Sol accepts Claude Code default thinking through CLIProxyAPI when tool count is under 128
why: The first probe failed on the documented 128-tool limit; strict MCP isolated thinking compatibility
result: Sol returned OK over translated /v1/messages

decision: Treat qbraid-api and qbraid-code as a coordinated contract despite an empty impact route
why: The mapper does not index qbraid-code; zero consumers is a coverage gap, not safety
result: required deploy order will be explicit

decision: Captured primary-source constraints in the repository research note
why: Claude Code has process-wide context policy, no organization field in status JSON, and no in-process credential switch
result: research complete

decision: Removed legacy --global gateway env from the viable profile design
why: A fake gateway proved user settings env overrides process env and would silently select the wrong profile
result: settings precedence reproduced

decision: Included adaptive display and effort in the API fix contract
why: Claude Code sent adaptive display omitted and output_config effort high; qbraid-api currently drops both
result: wire shape captured

decision: Selected per-profile directories with an atomic active pointer
why: It isolates secrets, proxies, ports, and caches without a daemon or registry parser
result: arena dropouts documented; selected

decision: Preserved adaptive type, display, and effort at the Bedrock provider boundary
why: Live Claude Code payload and SDK serialization proved all three fields are meaningful
result: focused tests and typecheck green

decision: Removed plain-Claude --global mode
why: Project settings can override only the base URL and exfiltrate a user-settings bearer
evidence: Claude 2.1.238 fake-gateway precedence probe; contested review
result: installer rejects --global and removes legacy gateway env

decision: Replaced mutable profile directories with atomic metadata generations
why: A crash between in-place writes mixed credentials, labels, models, and proxy state
evidence: failed-update fixture with rotated key and disabled proxy
result: current pointer changes only after a complete generation

decision: Moved keys to OS vaults with a Linux 0600 fallback
why: Status hooks and Claude tools must never receive the reusable upstream key
evidence: Keychain/Credential Locker guidance; secret-free snapshot tests
result: Claude receives only a random per-launch loopback bearer

decision: Replaced shared profile proxies with per-launch owned proxies
why: Refcounts and shared ports created teardown, update, and Terminal Services races
evidence: real CLIProxyAPI launch; occupied-port fixture; contested review
result: runtime config is unlinked after health and process stops on exit

decision: Disabled gateway model discovery and required relaunch for model changes
why: Claude Code context policy is process-wide while gateway rows span 200k to 1m
result: each process has one conservative capability policy

decision: Kept the private runtime config until proxy shutdown
why: CLIProxyAPI starts its file watcher after the first healthy response and exits if the config was already unlinked
evidence: CLIProxyAPI 6.8.40 delayed watcher repro; watcher-lifetime fixture
result: supersedes early-unlink result; cleanup removes the private runtime directory

decision: Pruned superseded generations and credentials after atomic commit
why: Profile updates already reject live sessions, so retaining old keys only enlarged exposure
evidence: rotated-key fixture checks old generation and secret removal
result: only current generation remains recoverable

decision: Scrubbed plaintext legacy env after vault migration
why: Running sessions already hold launch credentials and status needs only label/cache files
evidence: migration fixture checks non-secret root state remains
result: idempotent migration leaves no root token duplicate

decision: Preferred Linux Secret Service and retained a 0600 headless fallback
why: Desktop Linux provides an OS credential store but minimal servers may not
evidence: fake secret-tool migration and failure fallback fixtures
result: secret-service backend selected only after a successful store

decision: Rendered a shortened verified organization-ID tag beside local labels
why: API-key auth often lacks an authoritative organization name
evidence: organization-id provenance file and status fixture
result: local text stays marked and gains verified account evidence

decision: Kept proxy healthy after delayed watcher initialization
why: First health can precede CLIProxyAPI watcher startup
evidence: real CLIProxyAPI delayed second /v1/models returned HTTP 200; runtime removed on exit
result: per-launch config lifetime and cleanup verified

decision: Deferred legacy plaintext scrub until successful generation commit
why: Immediate scrub broke the old launcher when later installation steps failed
evidence: pre-commit migration fixture retains root token; post-commit helper scrubs it
result: supersedes immediate-scrub timing while preserving final no-duplicate state

decision: Removed legacy secret-bearing proxy config after safe handoff
why: The old singleton proxy template embedded the upstream key twice
evidence: migration fixture covers inactive cleanup, live watcher preservation, and dead-owner scavenging
result: new launchers remove residue once no legacy proxy watches it
